Plugin Pages 3.0+ applies integration changes without a server restart. Older versions need a restart after first enabling integration.

Native Home links combine an allocated tab index with jeTab=bookmarks, jeTab=hidden-content, jeTab=activity, or jeTab=catchup. Use JE's generated links rather than a fixed tab number. See JE Pages & Tabs for complete placement instructions.

docs.title: Header Shortcuts
docs.text:
JE shortcuts share a single header row with Jellyfin's controls, so you can reach common actions quickly. Shortcuts that do not fit move into a menu and return as you widen the window.

How to use:

  1. Click the ••• button, More from Jellyfin Enhanced, to open More from JE.
  2. Choose a labeled action. On short screens, use Previous page and Next page to see the remaining actions.
  3. Close with the close button, by choosing an action, clicking outside, or pressing Esc.

There is no separate setting for this automatic layout. Each shortcut follows its feature's availability. Random gets first priority; other enabled shortcuts stay visible while there is room.

Header shortcuts move into More from JE as the screen narrows.

docs.title: Random Button
docs.text:
Use the dice button to pick a random title when you cannot decide what to watch. It opens the title's detail page without starting playback.

Random button opens two library titles.

How to use:

  1. Open Random Button Settings to choose item types and a source. Keep at least one of Movies and Shows selected.
  2. Click the dice button or press the stock R shortcut outside the player. Inside the player, R resets playback speed.

Personal settings in Random Button Settings:

Setting Default What it does Enable Random Button On Shows the dice button. Unwatched Only Off Includes unplayed movies/episodes and shows with unplayed episodes. Movies On Includes movies. Shows On Includes series and, inside playlists/collections, episodes. Use the playlist or collection I'm viewing Off Gives the open playlist/collection detail page priority over a pinned source. Everywhere else, pick from Whole library Under Random Source, pins an accessible playlist or collection for other pages. This choice is personal only.

Matching initial defaults are under admin Display → Random Button:

Setting Default What it does Enable Random Button On Initial button visibility. Show unwatched only Off Initial watched-state filter. Include movies On Initial movie selection. Include shows On Initial show selection. Scope to the current playlist or collection Off Starting behavior for the playlist or collection you are viewing. How random selection works

JE samples up to 100 randomly ordered candidates, then applies the unwatched filter. Playlists and collections supply only their direct children; the whole-library query includes nested items.

If a pinned source is unavailable or a playlist/collection sample has no eligible titles, JE falls back directly to the library and shows a toast. It bypasses any other pinned source. An empty eligible library sample shows an error. An empty sample does not mean every item in the source is ineligible.

docs.title: Content Management
docs.text: Keep titles you do not want to see out of your browsing lists, or clear individual home rows without changing your playback progress.

docs.title: Hidden Content System
docs.text:
Hide titles from the browsing lists whose filters you enable. Your hidden list follows your account across devices.

Hiding does not restrict access

You can still open hidden titles directly and play them. “Everywhere” means only the browsing areas whose filters are enabled.

How to hide:

  1. Ask an administrator to enable Pages → Hidden Content → Enable Hidden Content.
  2. Open a movie, series, season, or episode detail page and click the open-eye Hide button. Movies, series, and seasons use a standard confirmation. An episode with a known series offers Hide this episode everywhere or Hide entire show everywhere.

If Show in Library Views is on, you can also use card eye buttons. In Continue Watching or Next Up, their choice dialog can limit a hide to that row: Remove from Continue Watching or Hide from Next Up only. These choices are separate from detail-page hiding.

An already-hidden item shows a crossed-out eye; use it to Unhide. After a hide, the Undo toast lasts eight seconds. A new hide replaces the previous toast.

Hiding a library movie and restoring it with Undo.

How to manage: Open Hidden Content through its configured entry, or choose Manage Hidden Content in the personal section. The page presents Movies, expandable Series groups, and Cast / Actors.

  • Search hidden items… matches item and series names.
  • Scoped only shows non-global entries, rather than selecting a particular scope. Badges distinguish Continue Watching only, Next Up only, and Home sections only.
  • Expand All / Collapse All opens or closes series groups.
  • Unhide restores an entry; Add back to Continue Watching restores a Continue Watching-only entry. Unhide All for This Show clears a series group.
  • Unhide All clears the entire list, even if search or Scoped only currently shows a subset.

Personal settings in the Enhanced panel's Hidden Content section start from admin Pages → Hidden Content defaults. The table includes matching admin labels. Button visibility and filtering are separate:

Setting Default What it does Enable Content Hiding On Enables personal filtering without deleting entries when turned off. Admin: Hidden Content enabled by default. Show Hide Buttons On Shows eye buttons; turning it off preserves filtering. Admin: Show "Hide" buttons by default. Show Confirmation Dialog On Confirms standard hides. Admin: Show confirmation dialog before hiding. Show on Seerr Items On Shows eye buttons on supported Seerr results. Admin: Show "Hide" button on Seerr search results. Show in Library Views Off Shows eye buttons on library/home cards. Admin: Show "Hide" button on library / home cards. Show on Detail Pages On Shows eye buttons on supported media detail pages. Admin: Show "Hide" button on item details pages. Show on Cast/Actors Off Adds hiding on cast cards and person detail pages. Admin: Show "Hide" button on cast / actor cards. Filter Library On Filters library lists and supported detail-page lists. Admin: Filter Library & details pages. Filter Search Off Filters supported Jellyfin and Seerr search results. Admin: Filter Search results. Filter Continue Watching On Filters that home row, including row-specific hides. Filter Next Up On Filters that home row, including row-specific hides. Filter Upcoming On Filters upcoming episodes. Admin: Filter Upcoming episodes. Filter Recommendations On Filters supported suggestions/recommendation results. Admin: Filter Suggestions / recommendations. Filter Discovery On Filters JE's Seerr discovery results. Filter Calendar On Filters JE's Calendar. Filter Requests On Filters JE's Requests page. Admin: Filter Requests page. Hide Collections & Libraries Off Experimental: allows hiding My Media libraries, collections, and playlists with library-card buttons enabled, without recursively hiding every child. Admin: Allow hiding collections, libraries, and playlists (experimental).

Admin settings in Pages → Hidden Content:

Setting Default What it does Enable Hidden Content Off Loads the full feature, personal section, and management page. Add Hidden Content as a native Home tab Off Adds a built-in Home tab; its shortcut is available when the tab button is hidden. Use Plugin Pages for Hidden Content Off Adds the page to Plugin Pages. Use Custom Tabs for Hidden Content Off Uses a Custom Tabs entry instead of a native tab. Add the Custom Tabs entry for me Off Creates/manages the JE-owned entry on save. Hidden Content details

Plugin Pages uses /JellyfinEnhanced/hiddenContentPage. For manual Custom Tabs setup, use:

<div class="jellyfinenhanced hidden-content"></div>

Standard confirmation offers Don't ask again for 15 minutes. This preference is local to your browser and specific to your account. Show Confirmation Dialog controls the persistent preference. Episode/show and home-row choice dialogs still appear when you need to choose an action.

The other filter labels are identical in the personal and admin interfaces. Hidden Content preferences are saved with your per-account list on the server in hidden-content.json, separately from ordinary personal settings. The standalone #/hidden-content route opens only with native Home tab and Custom Tabs placement off and no detected Plugin Pages integration for Hidden Content. See the standalone-route table for navigation conditions.

Cast hiding saves the person as a hidden item; it does not hide every movie or show featuring that person. A series hide can suppress its episodes and seasons through their series ID.

Server filtering also affects clients consuming covered Jellyfin list endpoints, even if they cannot show JE's eye buttons. Native filtering matches Jellyfin item/series IDs; Seerr filtering matches TMDB IDs. A Seerr-only hide does not guarantee hiding a later-added library item.

Calendar filtering also matches normalized names, which can collide. Deleting a library item removes entries for its Jellyfin ID. Home Screen Sections' synthetic discovery/upcoming results are not equivalent to JE's integration results.

docs.title: Remove from Continue Watching / Next Up
docs.text:
Remove an item from a home row while preserving its playback position and watched state. Row-specific hides are stored server-side for your account.

How to use:

  1. Open an item's ⋯ menu, right-click menu, or long-press/multi-select menu in Continue Watching or Next Up.
  2. Choose Remove from Continue Watching or Remove from Next Up. Mixed selections from removable rows use Remove; selections from one row use its specific label.

For multiple removable items, confirm the list of titles and rows. A single removable item needs no bulk confirmation.

Setting Default What it does Enable "Remove from Continue Watching" — admin Display Off Enables server row filtering and supplies the initial personal removal-button default. Add Remove from Continue Watching & Next Up Buttons — personal UI Settings Off Adds the menu actions. Turning it off retains earlier hides.

To restore entries manually, enable the full Hidden Content feature and use its management page: Add back to Continue Watching for Continue Watching-only entries, Unhide for Next Up or combined entries. Confirm with Unhide in the dialog.

Remove a movie, restore it through Hidden Content, and return to its saved playback progress.

Keep removed items out of the row

Lasting filtering needs the server's removal setting or Enable Hidden Content, plus personal Enable Content Hiding and the relevant Filter Continue Watching / Filter Next Up setting.

Row removal and restoration

With both server features off, a personal button can save the hide and remove the current card, but later server responses are not filtered. First-time removal enables personal filtering; existing Hidden Content preferences are retained.

Items outside removable rows are ignored, although a card carrying a playback position can be recognized as Continue Watching. Requests run separately, so a batch can partly succeed. Canceling or total failure preserves the selection. Successful removals also hide empty home sections. Home Screen Sections rows, including its combined Continue Watching/Next Up row, are supported.

Removing the same item from both rows combines the hide; global and already-combined hides are preserved.

Resuming clears a matching Continue Watching-only hide. A combined hide becomes Next Up-only, restoring Continue Watching visibility. Next Up-only and global hides remain until removed manually. Episode playback can also match a hide saved against its series.

docs.title: Admin: Other Users' Hidden Content
docs.text:
As an administrator, you can review and manage other users' hidden lists from the same Hidden Content page.

How to use:

  1. Select a user from View user's hidden content. The picker appears when another user has hidden entries. My hidden content returns to your own list.
  2. Choose Edit to restore entries, or Add items to search for titles. Enter at least two characters. In library and Discover distinguish sources.
  3. Click Hide to add a global hide. Already hidden entries are skipped, preserving the user's existing hide.
  4. Choose Done to return to read-only mode. Unhide All in edit mode clears the selected user's entire list.

Admin Pages → Hidden Content → Admin Controls:

Setting Default What it does Let admins view and manage other users' hidden content On Enables both cross-user viewing and editing when Hidden Content is enabled. Turn it off to disable these controls. Cross-user access and search

Access is checked server-side. Switching users clears search/scoped filtering and opens a read-only list with Viewing: {userName}.

JE requests up to 24 library matches using the admin's library access and also searches Seerr when available.

docs.title: Playback & Controls
docs.text: Use shortcuts, bookmarks, and player preferences to make watching more comfortable.

docs.title: Advanced Keyboard Shortcuts
docs.text:
Navigate Jellyfin and control local video playback without opening menus. Admin bindings supply defaults; you can override or disable individual JE actions for your account.

Opening shortcut help over the player and returning to playback.

How to use: Press the keys below outside text input fields. To customize them:

  1. Open Shortcuts in the Enhanced panel.
  2. Click or focus a binding to show Waiting…, then press a key combination.
  3. While listening, use Backspace to restore the current admin default, or Del or the disable control to mark the action Disabled. Re-enabling restores the admin default.
Changing, disabling and resetting a keyboard shortcut.

Global action Stock key What it does Open Search / Opens search. Go to Home Shift+H Opens Home. Go to Dashboard D Opens the dashboard; Jellyfin permissions still apply. Quick Connect Q Opens Quick Connect. Play Random Item R Opens random item details when the dice button is available. Player action Stock key What it does Cycle Aspect Ratio A Cycles Auto → Cover → Fill. Show Playback Info I Toggles JE's statistics overlay. Subtitle Menu S Opens the subtitle menu. Cycle Subtitle Tracks C Cycles tracks, including Off. Cycle Audio Tracks V Cycles audio tracks, without an Off option. Increase Playback Speed + Steps up through 0.25×, 0.5×, 0.75×, 1×, 1.25×, 1.5×, 1.75×, and 2×. Decrease Playback Speed - Steps down through those speeds. Reset Playback Speed R Returns to 1×. Bookmark Current Time B Opens Add Bookmark when Bookmarks is enabled. Open Episode Preview P Clicks the existing preview button; requires the separate InPlayerEpisodePreview plugin. Skip Intro/Outro O Skips the current segment. Step Back One Frame , Pauses and seeks back one estimated frame. Step Forward One Frame . Pauses and seeks forward one estimated frame. Jump to Last Position Z Returns once to the position saved before the last seek. Jump to % of video 0–9 Seeks to 0%, 10%, … 90%. Can be disabled but not rebound. Setting Default What it does Disable Keyboard Shortcuts — admin Keyboard Off Disables ordinary JE shortcuts and hides Shortcuts. The ? panel shortcut still works outside text fields. Shortcuts Panel Autoclose Delay (ms) — admin Playback 15000 Closes the panel after the configured delay while the pointer is outside it. Shortcut behavior and admin bindings

Modifier-only presses are ignored. Conflicts and reserved native player bindings are rejected with a red shake; a dot marks personal overrides. Changes save in your server-side shortcuts.json.

Administrators can set server bindings in Keyboard → Keyboard Config using its recorder, then Save Settings. While recording there, Del disables an action and Backspace restores its stock binding. Existing personal overrides still take precedence.

Held C or V does not repeatedly cycle tracks. Frame stepping uses media frame-rate metadata. When it is missing, JE falls back to 24 fps and shows a notice.

Cycle Aspect Ratio stores Jellyfin's aspect ratio in this browser and adjusts graphical-subtitle canvases. Show Playback Info refreshes the statistics overlay every second while open. Skip Intro/Outro seeks past the segment containing the current position, including other segment types, and falls back to an available native skip button. It is independent of auto-skip settings.

docs.title: Smart Bookmarks
docs.text:
Save moments in a video and return to them from timeline markers or a library-wide page. Your bookmarks are personal and stored on the server.

How to use:

  1. During playback, press B or click the bookmark-add player button.
  2. In Add Bookmark, Time is captured when opening begins and is read-only. Enter Label (optional), up to 100 characters.
  3. Click Add Bookmark to save. Click its timeline marker to jump there. Existing Bookmarks also offers jump and delete controls.
  4. Open Bookmarks through its navigation entry. Use Movies, Series, or Others; the last group covers items outside Movie/Episode groupings. Click a timestamp/play icon to start there. Edit a time in seconds or HH:MM:SS and change its label.

Saving a bookmark and jumping back to it during playback.

Admin Pages → Bookmarks:

Setting Default What it does Enable Bookmarks Feature On Enables creation, timeline markers, and management. Add Bookmarks as a native Home tab Off Adds a built-in Home tab and a shortcut when its tab button is hidden. Use Plugin Pages for Bookmarks Library Off Adds the page to Plugin Pages. Use Custom Tabs for Bookmarks Off Uses Custom Tabs instead of a native tab. Add the Custom Tabs entry for me Off Manages the entry on save. Bookmark storage and matching

Plugin Pages uses /JellyfinEnhanced/bookmarksPage. For manual Custom Tabs setup, use:

<div class="sections bookmarks"></div>

Your bookmarks are stored in bookmark.json. The standalone #/bookmarks route opens only with native Home tab and Custom Tabs placement off and no detected Plugin Pages integration for Bookmarks. See the standalone-route table for navigation conditions.

Markers for the exact item are cyan. If that item has no exact bookmarks, matching TMDB/TVDB IDs can provide orange fallback markers with File may have changed since bookmark was created.

Episode matching checks saved season/episode identity when present. Legacy records without it can match by provider ID alone. Timestamps are reused without adjusting for different edits of the video.

Merge duplicates, adjust timing, or recover a replaced file

Find Duplicates → Merge to Primary copies matching bookmarks to the first item key in the stored duplicate group. “Primary” is not a detected preferred Jellyfin version. Originals remain; repeated merges can create copies. Episode duplicate/replacement matching preserves available season/episode identity.

On the resulting item, use Adjust Offset, enter positive or negative Time Offset (seconds), then Apply Offset. Only copied records still marked as synchronized are shifted, with times clamped at zero. Successful updates clear their synchronization markers; a zero offset clears markers without shifting times.

For an Orphaned item, use Find Replacement, select a matching library item, then Migrate Bookmarks. Migration moves records and removes the old ones after a successful save. The replacement button needs a saved TMDB ID; matching can also use TVDB. Search checks at most the newest 500 candidates, so an older replacement may not appear.

Failed saves show feedback and roll back changes; a failed migration preserves the original records. Bookmark writes are serialized within the client.

Warning

Individual deletion is immediate. Delete All asks for confirmation and has no undo. Recover replacements before Cleanup Orphaned: cleanup treats failed item lookups as missing, so network or access failures can cause unintended deletion. There is no bookmark export/import control.

docs.title: Custom Pause Screen
docs.text:
After you pause and stop interacting, JE can display artwork and media information over the video.

How to use:

  1. Enable Custom Pause Screen in Playback Settings.
  2. Pause and wait for the idle delay. Interaction postpones its appearance; moving the pointer after it appears leaves the overlay visible.
  3. Press Space / Enter or click/tap the background to resume. × dismisses without resuming and prevents another overlay during that pause.
Pause screen appears after a delay and disappears on resume. Setting Default What it does Enable Custom Pause Screen — admin Playback → Playback & Tab Switch On Supplies the initial personal default. Custom Pause Screen — personal Playback Settings On Enables the overlay; reload after changing enablement. Delay before showing (seconds): — personal Playback Settings 5 Idle delay while paused; accepts integers from 1–60 and updates the running delay.

The overlay shows the year, official age rating, runtime, description, elapsed/total time, watched percentage, and estimated Ends at time. See CSS Customization for styling.

Pause-screen artwork and layout

Logo, disc, and blurred backdrop depend on available item/parent/series artwork. A missing logo does not guarantee a text-title fallback. Disc art hides on narrow layouts, can return in short landscape layouts, and stops rotating with reduced-motion preferences.

docs.title: Smart Playback
docs.text:
Manage tab-switch playback, temporary speed boosts, and automatic intro/outro skipping in the browser player.

The player also shows rating chips, a bookmark button, and the optional Playback Info overlay.

How to use: Open Playback Settings for tab-switch and hold controls, or Auto-Skip Settings for intros/outros. Admin defaults are under Playback → Playback & Tab Switch and Playback → Auto-Skip.

  • For continuous Picture-in-Picture playback, turn off Auto-pause.
  • For temporary 2× speed, hold the video background with the left mouse button or touch for 500 ms. Release or cancel to restore the previous speed. Hold only on the video background.
Holding the video temporarily increases playback to twice normal speed.

For auto-skip, you need Jellyfin's stored media segments from a provider such as Intro Skipper.

Setting Default What it does Auto-pause — personal; Auto-pause on tab switch — admin On Pauses playing video when the browser tab is hidden. Auto-resume — personal; Auto-resume on tab switch — admin Off Resumes only when JE recorded that it paused on leaving; does not resume a video already paused manually. Auto Picture-in-Picture — personal; Auto Picture-in-Picture on tab switch — admin Off Requests PiP when leaving and closes the PiP window JE opened when returning. Long Press for 2x Speed (β) — personal; Long press/hold for 2x speed β — admin Off Temporarily boosts speed while holding. Reload after first enabling. Automatically Skip Intro — personal; Auto-skip Intro — admin Off Seeks to the end of stored Intro segments. Automatically Skip Outro — personal; Auto-skip Outro — admin Off Seeks to the end of stored Outro segments. Playback behavior and limits

Picture-in-Picture: Auto-pause pauses playing video when the document is hidden. Auto-pause and PiP can run on the same visibility change. PiP needs browser support, loaded video metadata, and browser permission/activation. A request can be refused. Edge/Chrome may open their own automatic PiP; JE closes only the window it opened itself.

Temporary 2× speed: A speed indicator appears during the boost. Activation on a paused video attempts playback. Moving more than ten pixels before activation cancels the pending hold. OSD controls and the pause overlay are excluded, but the Enhanced panel is not reliably excluded.

Auto-skip: JE seeks to the exact stored segment end. It does not depend on an English button label or require Jellyfin's segment action to display a skip button. Segments need start/end boundaries and must last at least one second.

Seeking back inside a segment just skipped leaves you there. Seek before its start and play through it to skip again. Recap, Preview, and Commercial actions remain Jellyfin's responsibility; JE's automatic toggles cover only intros/outros. Outro skipping does not implement a separate auto-next feature; Jellyfin controls next-episode autoplay.

Failed segment retrieval or ambiguous playing-item identity can leave skipping inactive. Jellyfin stores segments per item, so multiple versions with different timings can use boundaries from the primary version.

Auto-skip uses a local seek

Direct play/direct stream and HLS are suitable. Progressive transcoding can stall beyond produced data, and SyncPlay peers do not follow this local seek.

docs.title: Customizable Subtitles
docs.text:
Style text subtitles with presets, colors, effects, and a live position preview. These preferences do not change Jellyfin's saved subtitle appearance settings.

How to use:

  1. During playback, open Subtitle Settings.
  2. Choose presets or edit Text / Background, and preview the result. Changes apply to supported text tracks.
  3. For positioning, set Jellyfin's Subtitle styling to Custom in user subtitle preferences, then click or drag the Position grid.

Personal Subtitle Settings, with initial defaults from admin Playback → Subtitles:

Setting Default What it does Style Clean White Sets preset text/background colors; admin Default Subtitle Style. Size Normal Selects size; admin Default Subtitle Size. Font Default Selects font; admin Default Subtitle Font. Text Effect Auto Selects shadow/outline; admin Default Subtitle Text Effect. Auto uses a shadow with the transparent preset or #00000000; a visible box, including a semi-transparent one, has no Auto shadow. Text White, #FFFFFFFF Custom text color/alpha. Background Transparent, #00000000 Custom background color/alpha. Position Horizontal 50%, vertical 85% for server-created settings Places the stack's lower edge; grid range is 2–98% on both axes. Disable Custom Styles Off Leaves styling to Jellyfin after reload; admin Disable Custom Subtitle Styles by default.
  • Style: Clean White, Classic Black Box, Netflix Style, Cinema Yellow, Soft Gray, High Contrast.
  • Size: Tiny, Small, Normal, Large, Extra Large, Gigantic.
  • Font: Default, Noto Sans, Sans Serif, Typewriter, Roboto (Roboto Mono).
  • Text Effect: Auto, None, Shadow, Outline, Outline + Shadow.

For white text on a semi-transparent black box like the example below, set Text to #FFFFFFFF and Background to #00000080. The last two digits set opacity.

To stop styling, turn on personal Disable Custom Styles and reload. To change the starting preference for everyone, save admin Disable Custom Subtitle Styles by default. Use Overwrite everyone's personal settings only if you intend to replace existing personal preferences.

Choose a supported text track

ASS / SSA, PGS, VobSub / DVD, DVB bitmap, and burned-in subtitles do not pass through the text element JE can restyle. Choose a text track such as SRT if you need these controls.

Subtitle colors, positioning, and support checks

Color alpha spans 0–255 using #RRGGBBAA. Editing colors enables custom colors. Choosing Style replaces both colors and returns to preset colors. Clean White stores its preset background as transparent. JE's custom text styling resets weight, italics, small-caps, and primary-track margins.

The position grid's client fallback and reset use (50,95).

Renderer Supported styling Jellyfin custom text element Color, background, size, font, effect, and position. Primary/secondary tracks share a position and stack together. Browser native captions Color, background, size, font, and effect. No position grid, custom padding, or rounded box.

The panel checks format when opened, using the first controllable session with a playing item and its primary subtitle stream. Reopen after changing tracks. It may reflect another session or miss a secondary track, so no warning is not proof of support.

docs.title: Player Ratings
docs.text:
See Jellyfin's community/critic scores in the player or briefly show age-rating information when playback starts. These are admin controls, independent of poster-tag switches.

How to use: Start playback to see the optional startup badge; reveal the player controls to see score chips beside the time information.

Admin Display → Media Tags and Playback → Playback & Tab Switch, respectively:

Setting Default What it does Show Rating in Video Player On Adds community/critic score chips to the player controls using Jellyfin rating fields. Show Age Rating When Playback Starts Off Shows official age rating, up to three recognized advisory tags, and up to three genres for five seconds. Rating metadata and visibility

Available metadata determines what appears. Episodes can use series data for missing age rating/genres and incorporate series advisory tags. These controls have no personal-panel toggle. Spoiler Guard can suppress protected information.

docs.title: Discovery & Integration
docs.text: Find missing media through connected services, share reviews, and see what others are watching.

docs.title: Seerr Search Integration
docs.text:
Search and request missing media from Jellyfin with Seerr.

How to use:

  1. Turn on admin Seerr → Enable Seerr integration (off by default).
  2. Configure and Test the connection, then link/import users.

Follow Seerr Features, Seerr Settings, and Permission Audit for requirements, search, request permissions, quotas, and watchlist options.

Existing setup illustrations

Illustrative external settings capture; its version is unknown. Its annotations do not establish JE's current account-import requirements.

These external icon illustrations show active, unlinked-user, and disabled styling. JE loads its own icons through its asset service; an active connection still requires request permission for request actions.

docs.title: Seerr Item Details
docs.text:
Seerr adds similar/recommended rows, discovery, request actions, and a More Info modal. You can control these features separately.

How to use: See Seerr Features and Seerr Settings for detail-page controls, collection discovery, exclusions, the standalone Recommendations page, and setup.

The standalone page is separate from similar/recommended rows on item details.

docs.title: .arr Links Integration
docs.text:
As an administrator, you can open matched titles in Sonarr, Radarr, or Bazarr. Synced Jellyfin tag links are a separate feature.

How to use: See *arr Features and *arr Settings for service setup, multiple instances, status badges, tag filters, and synchronization tasks.

docs.title: Streaming Provider Lookup
docs.text:
Elsewhere shows subscription streaming providers for a title in your region, including supported per-season lookups.

How to use:

  1. An administrator configures Enable Elsewhere and TMDB API Key under Elsewhere & Reviews.
  2. Choose regions/providers in a title's Elsewhere controls.

See Elsewhere & Reviews Features and Elsewhere & Reviews Settings for defaults and limits.

docs.title: User Reviews
docs.text: Share text reviews and star ratings for movies, series, seasons, and episodes with viewers on your server. See User Reviews for writing and moderation, and User Reviews settings for author visibility, poster averages, and Jellyfin rating mirroring.

docs.title: Activity Feed
docs.text:
See recently watched, favorited, and reviewed titles across the server, with an optional live session section.

How to use:

  1. Open Activity through the configured Home tab or Plugin Pages entry.
  2. Click titles/artwork to open details, or read stars/text previews. Watch History shows progress for partial watches and completed watching for completed ones. Favorites and reviews share the Reviews section.
  3. Use Refresh for an update.

Admin Pages → Activity Feed:

Setting Default What it does Enable Activity Feed Off Enables the page and watched/favorite collection. Show recently watched On Records and shows qualifying playback stops. Show recently favorited On Records and shows favorites. Show recently reviewed On Includes current review-store entries. Non-admins only see their own activity Off Regular users only see their own watched, favorited and reviewed entries; administrators still see everyone. Show Active Streams section On Adds live sessions when Active Streams is enabled and the viewer is allowed. Add Activity as a native Home tab Off Adds a built-in Home tab. Use Plugin Pages Off Adds the page to Plugin Pages. Use Custom Tabs Off Uses Custom Tabs instead of a native tab. Add the Custom Tabs entry for me Off Manages the entry on save.

The live section also requires admin Extras → UI Tweaks → Active Streams Header Widget. Non-admins need Show widget to non-admins.

Activity collection, access, and refresh

Plugin Pages uses /JellyfinEnhanced/activityPage. For manual Custom Tabs setup, use:

<div class="jellyfinenhanced activity"></div>

Watch History includes playback stopped at a position of at least 5% of known runtime, plus playback Jellyfin marks completed. This measures position, not time spent watching.

Only the live section polls every 15 seconds while visible, skipping hidden browser tabs. Stored history/review/favorite entries respect viewer library access and the review-author filters, with admin/self author exceptions. Live sessions use the separate Active Streams permission policy and can include titles outside the viewer's library access.

A standard feed request returns up to 50 merged entries without UI pagination. Watched/favorite storage in activity.json is capped at 500 entries, one per user/item/type. Rewatches update time while preserving highest progress and completion. Unfavoriting removes its entry.

Turning the feed off hides it and stops watched/favorite collection without deleting history. User Reviews continues independently, so reviews written while the feed is off can appear after re-enabling it.

docs.title: Catch Up
docs.text:
Sort unwatched movies and shows with a card deck. Touch, mouse, and keyboard actions update your own Jellyfin account.

How to use:

  1. Open Catch Up through the configured Home tab or Plugin Pages entry.
  2. Choose Movies or Shows.
  3. Use the gestures or keys below to sort your deck.
Gesture/control Keyboard What it does Swipe right Right Marks watched. Swipe left Left Dismisses from your deck in this browser. Swipe up Up Adds to your watchlist using Jellyfin's Likes flag. Swipe down Down Opens details. Rewind (Backspace) Backspace / Z Reverses the last watched, dismiss, or watchlist action in the current deck. Dismissing a Catch Up card and restoring it with Rewind.

For a show with at least two regular seasons, swiping right opens a season picker. Selecting a later season selects earlier ones; select a selected season again to untick just that season. Choose Mark {n} season(s) watched to confirm. Specials are not listed. Fewer regular seasons mark the whole series directly.

Admin Pages → Catch Up:

Setting Default What it does Enable Catch Up Off Enables the deck page. Record Catch Up activity On Records new actions when Catch Up is enabled; turning it off retains readable history and the admin panel. Add Catch Up as a native Home tab Off Adds a built-in Home tab. Use Plugin Pages Off Adds the page to Plugin Pages. Use Custom Tabs Off Uses Custom Tabs instead of a native tab. Add the Custom Tabs entry for me Off Manages the entry on save.

Rewind does not restore earlier ratings or watched state

Rewind reverses the action rather than restoring a saved snapshot. It does not preserve previous watched/liked/disliked state. A failed action can still remove the card and show Failed: {error}; rewind can also fail.

Deck selection, browser preferences, and rewind

Plugin Pages uses /JellyfinEnhanced/catchUpPage. For manual Custom Tabs setup, use:

<div class="jellyfinenhanced catchup"></div>

Decks use random batches of 40 unwatched accessible items, filtering dismissed, already-seen, and imageless cards. Nothing more to show here. can mean the sample yielded no new eligible cards.

Dismissals and the Movies/Shows choice are browser-local per-user preferences, separate from Hidden Content. Reloading retains dismissals; rewind or clearing the relevant browser storage removes them. Switching/restarting a deck clears its queue, seen set, and undo history.

The swipe-up Likes flag is the watchlist flag used by Seerr watchlist sync. Swiping down does not add an undo-history entry. Selecting all regular seasons writes the series ID; a subset writes selected season IDs.

Watched undo removes PlayedItems state, and watchlist undo removes the Likes rating.

For administrators:

  1. Open Activity, then Feed or Summary.
  2. In Feed, choose All users or a user, select action chips, or enter Search titles. No selected action chips means all actions. The feed shows up to 300 matching events.
  3. Use Refresh or Hide to update or close the panel.

On wide screens, Activity docks beside the deck; on narrower screens, it opens as a modal.

Catch Up admin activity

Summary counts distinct successful user/title actions after corresponding recorded undos. Most watched, Most dismissed, and Most watchlisted each show up to 15 titles. Feed filters do not affect Summary.

The open panel refreshes every ten seconds. It docks beside the deck at widths of at least 1100 pixels and opens as a modal on narrower screens. Non-admins cannot read these endpoints.

Logs include open, undo, and failed actions. They are client reports, not proof of viewing. Item names are resolved server-side. catchup-log.jsonl is bounded to about 5 MB per file with two files retained.

docs.title: TMDB Reviews
docs.text: Read TMDB reviews alongside local reviews on movie and series detail pages. See TMDB Reviews for setup, expansion, ordering, and fetching limits.

docs.title: Visual Enhancements
docs.text:
Add quality, genre, language, score, age-rating, and people information to cards with optional tags. All six tag families start off; detail-page information and awards are independent features.

How to use: See Tags for controls, prerequisites, caches, styles, native poster rendering, and audio-language tag synchronization.

This example enables all poster tag groups.

docs.title: Watch Progress
docs.text:
See how much you have watched on a title's detail page. You can check movies, series, seasons, episodes, collections, and playlists.

How to use:

  1. Enable Show Watch Progress in UI Settings.
  2. Open details and click the progress chip to cycle Percentage → Time Watched → Time Remaining. The selected mode saves for your account.
Watch progress cycles through percentage and time displays. Setting Default What it does Show watch progress — admin Display; Show Watch Progress — personal UI Settings Off Shows the detail-page chip. Watch Progress Default — admin Display Percentage Initial mode: Percentage, Time Watched, or Time Remaining; personal choices are in UI Settings. Watch Progress Time Format — admin Display h:m Initial duration format; personal h:m / yd:h:m choices are in UI Settings. Watch-progress calculation

For containers, progress adds together accessible leaf items. It depends on runtime metadata and ignores media-version selection.

docs.title: File Size and Audio Languages
docs.text:
See total file size and available audio languages in a title's detail information. These controls are independent of poster tags.

How to use:

  1. Open UI Settings and enable the chip you want.
  2. Open a detail page. Selecting another media version changes its size and audio-language data.
Setting Default What it does Show file sizes — admin Display; Show File Sizes — personal UI Settings Off Shows total file size. Show available audio languages on item detail page — admin Display; Show Audio Languages — personal UI Settings On Shows detail-page audio-language chips. Supported items and audio-language links

File size supports movies, series, seasons, episodes, collections, and playlists. Container sizes add together accessible leaf items. Audio languages supports movies, series, seasons, and episodes. Missing usable values display a dash.

When audio-language tag synchronization/linking is configured, a chip can open its matching Jellyfin tag page: regional tag first, base-language tag second, otherwise plain text. See Tags for that separate admin setup and task.

docs.title: Release and Air Dates
docs.text: See movie cinema, digital, and physical release dates or television air dates beside the item's metadata. See Release Dates for setup, region fallback, and date-selection rules.

docs.title: Awards
docs.text:
Expand an awards banner on detail pages to see Wikidata wins and nominations with categories, years, and recipients.

How to use:

  1. Enable Show Awards Banner in admin Display → Awards, save, and reload.
  2. Click the banner to expand it. Reviews do not need to be enabled.

Admin Display → Awards:

Setting Default What it does Show Awards Banner Off Enables Wikidata award lookups and display. Award sources, grouping, and caching

Movies and people use their own TMDB identity. Series use their series identity; seasons/episodes show their parent series' awards.

Entries sort newest year first, with wins before nominations within a year. Redundant nominations for a winning category/year are merged with recipients/work. Totals therefore count grouped entries rather than raw statements.

Wikidata coverage varies and is not exhaustive. No banner may mean no data or a failed lookup. The server's awards.json caches successful results for 180 days, confirmed empty results for 30 days, and failures for one hour.

docs.title: Personal Scripts
docs.text:
These optional extras are bundled with Jellyfin Enhanced, so you do not need a separate script installation. Despite this section's name, they are server switches.

How to use: As an administrator, enable them under Extras → UI Tweaks, save, and reload. See Other Features and Other Settings for the broader extras guide.

docs.title: Active Streams Widget
docs.text: Check playing and paused sessions from the header, and send a broadcast message as an administrator. See Active Streams Widget for setup, session details, refresh behavior, non-admin access, and broadcasts.

docs.title: Colored Activity Icons
docs.text:
Add predefined colors and icons to the Activity list on Jellyfin's dashboard home to make events easier to scan.

How to use: Enable Colored Dashboard Icons, save/reload, and open the dashboard.

Setting Default What it does Colored Dashboard Icons — admin Extras → UI Tweaks Off Styles supported dashboard events. Dashboard icon limits

Unmatched events keep their existing appearance. There is no color editor. This feature is separate from JE's Activity Feed.

docs.title: Colored Ratings
docs.text:
Color official parental/age classifications on detail pages, including supported international boards, US TV descriptors, and ESRB labels.

How to use: Enable Colored Ratings Backgrounds, save/reload, and open a classified title.

Setting Default What it does Colored Ratings Backgrounds — admin Extras → UI Tweaks Off Applies predefined classification colors. Classification colors

The capture shows colored G, PG-13, and R badges on Toy Story, The Dark Knight, and Oppenheimer detail pages. Supported classifications extend beyond these examples. This feature does not style numeric review scores.

docs.title: Login Image Display
docs.text:
Show a public user's avatar above the password field on the manual-login form. When the avatar is available, the name input is visually hidden.

How to use:

  1. Enable Profile Picture on Login.
  2. Select a public user on the login page, or enter a name matching an existing public user card.
Setting Default What it does Profile Picture on Login — admin Extras → UI Tweaks Off Adds the avatar to the manual-login form. When no avatar appears

No matching card/image or an image-load failure leaves or restores the name input. This does not discover hidden accounts through another lookup.

docs.title: Plugin Icons
docs.text:
Add Material icons and image logos to supported dashboard plugin links, plus optional links to other configuration pages.

How to use:

  1. Enable Custom Plugin Menu Icons and save/reload.
  2. For additional links, fill in Sidebar Custom Links using the format below.
  3. Use Test Links to preview temporary sidebar entries until refresh. Save Settings persists them.

Setting Default What it does Custom Plugin Menu Icons — admin Extras → UI Tweaks Off Enables bundled plugin icon mappings and custom links. Sidebar Custom Links — admin Extras → External Links Empty Adds configuration-page links using the format below. Custom sidebar link format

Enter one decoded exact configuration-page name and Material icon per line, for example:

Configuration Page Name | Material Icon Name

Preview requires the icon script to have initialized after enabling it.

See Other Features for supported plugin mappings.

docs.title: Theme Selector
docs.text:
Choose a Jellyfish color variant from the Theme row in Jellyfin user preferences.

Jellyfish installation required

Jellyfish must be installed natively. The admin guidance excludes the KefinTweaks installation method.

How to use:

  1. After an administrator enables the selector, open Jellyfin user preferences.
  2. Select a variant. Selection fades and reloads the page. Default removes the variant override.
  3. To enable Daily, click the shuffle button titled Random daily theme.
Setting Default What it does Theme Selector (Jellyfish) — admin Extras → UI Tweaks Off Adds the Theme row. Random daily theme — user preferences Theme Off Enables daily variant selection. Theme storage and daily timing

Variant/daily choices are stored per user in this browser, rather than in server-synced Enhanced settings. Daily mode chooses a variant during initialization when the saved UTC calendar date differs. It is not a midnight timer.

docs.title: Customization
docs.text: Adjust Jellyfin's appearance and choose the language for JE's interface.

docs.title: Custom Styling with CSS
docs.text:
Customize the pause screen, Enhanced panel, player score chips, tag overlays, and synced *arr tag links with Jellyfin custom CSS.

How to use: See CSS Customization for selectors and examples, and Tags for JE's built-in Tag Styles controls.

docs.title: Custom Branding
docs.text: Replace Jellyfin's logos, banners, favicon, and touch icon with your own uploads, or show your logo during startup. See Custom Branding for uploads and storage, Splash Screen for the loading overlay, and branding settings for asset slots and filenames.

docs.title: Internationalization
docs.text: Open Language Settings → Display Language and choose a language or Auto; your choice saves and reloads the page. Use Clear Translation Cache in the same section to clear this browser's translations and reload. See Internationalization for language precedence, loading, and server invalidation, and language settings for defaults.

docs.title: Enhanced settings
docs.text: Use the Enhanced panel for your preferences, or Dashboard → Plugins → Jellyfin Enhanced for server features and new users' starting values. This page covers Enhanced; Tags & Badges and specialist settings pages cover their own controls. Defaults below are for plugin 12.12.0.0; your administrator may choose different starting values.

docs.title: Enhanced Panel
docs.text:
The Enhanced panel lets you choose how Jellyfin Enhanced works for your account. Ordinary users can open it without Plugin Pages or Custom Tabs.

How to open it on desktop:

  • In Jellyfin 12's Modern layout, open your avatar menu and choose Jellyfin Enhanced.
  • If you have a sidebar, choose Enhanced Panel under Jellyfin Enhanced.
  • In Jellyfin's user preferences menu, choose Jellyfin Enhanced - User Settings.
  • Press ? outside an input or textarea. This works even when the administrator disables ordinary keyboard shortcuts.

How to open it on a phone:

  • Open the navigation drawer and tap Enhanced Panel.
  • Choose Jellyfin Enhanced in the Jellyfin 12 avatar menu, or Jellyfin Enhanced - User Settings in user preferences.
  • During playback, reveal the controls and tap the tune icon titled Jellyfin Enhanced.

In mobile or TV web layouts, the player button appears beside the native settings button when those controls are available. Desktop web layouts hide it.

Use Search settings… to filter sections by their contents, then select a section. On a phone, use the back-arrow button to return to the section list. Close the panel with ×, Esc, or ? outside editable fields. On desktop, you can drag the header to move it.

Use a supported web client

The panel needs a client that runs Jellyfin Enhanced's injected web scripts. If your native client cannot run them, change your account's preferences through the web client. Available entry points depend on your web client's layout and controls.

How it works

The sections are Shortcuts, Playback Settings, Auto-Skip Settings, Subtitle Settings, Random Button Settings, UI Settings, Hidden Content, Spoiler Guard, Language Settings, and About. Shortcuts is hidden when the administrator disables shortcuts. Hidden Content and Spoiler Guard require their server features to be enabled.

On desktop, the panel restores your last-opened section. A new account starts at Shortcuts, or the first available section if shortcuts are disabled. At widths up to 760 pixels, the panel fills the screen and starts with the section list. Tap a section to open it.

The panel can close automatically when the pointer is outside it. The administrator controls the delay, initially 15 seconds.

Modern layout has a mobile drawer rather than a desktop sidebar. Legacy layout has the sidebar. Jellyfin's user preferences menu uses #/mypreferencesmenu.

docs.title: Saving and syncing
docs.text:
Your changes save automatically to your account on the server. There is no personal Save button.

  1. Sign in with the same account on another browser or device to load your saved preferences.
  2. Reload an already-open client to load all changes made elsewhere.
  3. Follow any refresh message shown by a control.

Changing Custom Pause Screen or Disable Custom Styles asks you to refresh. Reload after first enabling Long Press for 2x Speed (β).

How it works

Opening the panel fetches fresh general settings. There is no live synchronization of every running feature. Many controls update the current client directly, including shortcut bindings, subtitle styling, and random-picker preferences. The first reload after enabling the speed gesture installs its listeners.

Each account has separate files on the Jellyfin server:

File What it stores settings.json General preferences. shortcuts.json Shortcut overrides. hidden-content.json Hidden Content preferences and hidden items. spoilerblur.json Spoiler Guard preferences and protected-title lists.

They are stored under:

<PluginsPath>/configurations/Jellyfin.Plugin.JellyfinEnhanced/<user-id>/

Browser storage still holds caches and local interface state. Language resolution has both a browser preference and a server preference. Catch Up dismissals stay in that browser. Those exceptions are explained below. Clearing caches does not replace your server-stored personal settings.

docs.title: Shortcuts
docs.text:
Shortcuts let you navigate Jellyfin and control playback from your keyboard. Your keys start from the administrator's Keyboard configuration, and you can choose your own overrides.

  1. Open Shortcuts. Actions are grouped under Global and Player.
  2. Click or focus a binding and wait for Waiting….
  3. Press the new combination. A dot titled Modified by user marks your override.

While the editor is listening, Backspace restores the current administrator binding. Del or the adjacent disable button disables the action. Re-enabling also restores the administrator binding.

The stock bindings are:

Setting Default What it does Open Search / Clicks the header search control and focuses search when available. Go to Home Shift+H Opens Home. Go to Dashboard D Opens the dashboard; Jellyfin permissions still apply. Quick Connect Q Opens Quick Connect. Play Random Item R Clicks the random button outside the player; opens an item's details. Cycle Aspect Ratio A Changes the video aspect ratio in the player. Show Playback Info I Shows playback information in the player. Subtitle Menu S Opens the player's subtitle menu. Cycle Subtitle Tracks C Cycles subtitle tracks. Cycle Audio Tracks V Cycles audio tracks. Increase Playback Speed + Moves up one speed step. Decrease Playback Speed - Moves down one speed step. Reset Playback Speed R Returns to 1× in the player. Bookmark Current Time B Opens bookmark creation at the current position when bookmarks are enabled. Open Episode Preview P Opens the preview using the existing button; requires the InPlayerEpisodePreview companion plugin. Skip Intro/Outro O Skips the current intro/outro. Step Back One Frame , Pauses and seeks backward by an estimated frame duration. Step Forward One Frame . Pauses and seeks forward by an estimated frame duration. Jump to Last Position Z Returns once to the saved position before your last seek. Jump to % of video 0–9 Seeks to 0%, 10%, … 90% of the video.

Ordinary shortcuts do not fire while an input or textarea is focused. See Enhanced features for the player tools.

Details

The editor rejects modifier-only presses, conflicting bindings, and reserved native player keys for player actions. Invalid combinations flash red and shake. Jump to % of video can be disabled but cannot be rebound.

Open Episode Preview clicks the existing InPlayerEpisodePreview button. Skip Intro/Outro seeks to the end of the current Media Segment, falling back to the visible skip button. Jump to Last Position consumes its saved target when used.

Frame stepping uses timestamp seeking. It falls back to 24 fps with a notice when frame-rate metadata is unavailable. Speed steps are 0.25×, 0.5×, 0.75×, 1×, 1.25×, 1.5×, 1.75×, and 2×.

docs.title: Playback Settings
docs.text:
Choose what happens when you leave a video tab and what you see while a video is paused. These are per-user preferences.

Open Playback Settings and turn on the behavior you want.

Setting Default What it does Auto-pause On Pauses a playing video when the browser tab becomes hidden. Auto-resume Off Resumes on return if JE paused the video when you left. Auto Picture-in-Picture Off Tries to open browser PiP when you leave the tab and closes PiP that JE opened when you return. Long Press for 2x Speed (β) Off Hold the video for 500 ms for temporary 2× playback; release or cancel to restore the previous rate. Mouse and touch are supported. Custom Pause Screen On Shows artwork and playback information after idle time while paused. Refresh after changing the toggle. Delay before showing (seconds): 5 Sets the pause-screen idle delay, from 1–60 whole seconds. Updates the running pause screen immediately.

On the pause screen, press Space/Enter or tap the background to resume. × dismisses the overlay for the rest of that pause without resuming. See Enhanced features for the pause screen and playback controls.

Keep playing in Picture-in-Picture

Turn Auto-pause off if you want continuous playback in PiP. Auto-pause and PiP can both run when you leave the tab. PiP needs browser support and an eligible video; the browser may refuse the request.

Details

Auto-resume does not resume a video you had already paused manually before leaving.

Reload after first enabling Long Press for 2x Speed (β). Moving more than ten pixels before the hold activates cancels it. Holding a paused video attempts to start playback.

Pause-screen artwork depends on the item's available images.

docs.title: Auto-Skip Settings
docs.text:
Auto-skip lets you move past intros and outros during web playback. You can choose either type separately for your account.

Open Auto-Skip Settings and turn on the segment types you want to skip.

Setting Default What it does Automatically Skip Intro Off Seeks to the end of an Intro segment. Automatically Skip Outro Off Seeks to the end of an Outro segment.

Intro/outro data required

Auto-skip needs usable Intro/Outro segment data, commonly supplied by Intro Skipper. The panel says Depends on Intro-Skipper Plugin being available.

How it works

JE reads Jellyfin's Media Segments API. It does not need a visible or English-language skip button. Segments without start/end boundaries or shorter than one second are ignored. Failed segment retrieval or an ambiguous playing-item identity can leave auto-skip inactive. If you seek back into a skipped segment, you can watch it without immediately skipping again.

Direct play and HLS work best. Progressive transcoding may not have produced the target yet. These local seeks do not synchronize a SyncPlay group. Outro skipping seeks to the segment end; Jellyfin remains responsible for next-episode autoplay.

docs.title: Subtitle Settings
docs.text:
Make text subtitles easier to read with your preferred colors, size, and position. These are per-user preferences for the web player.

  1. Open Subtitle Settings and choose a preset.
  2. Adjust the preview, or use the color and opacity controls.
  3. To use positioning, set Jellyfin's own subtitle appearance to Custom.

Setting Default What it does Disable Custom Styles Off Uses Jellyfin's subtitle styling instead of JE's overrides. Refresh after changing it. Style Clean White Chooses Clean White, Classic Black Box, Netflix Style, Cinema Yellow, Soft Gray, or High Contrast. Choosing a style replaces custom text/background colors. Text Opaque white (#FFFFFFFF) Sets text color and opacity; the opacity slider runs from 0–255. Background Transparent (#00000000) Sets background color and opacity, also 0–255. Size Normal Chooses Tiny, Small, Normal, Large, Extra Large, or Gigantic. Font Default Chooses Default, Noto Sans, Sans Serif, Typewriter, or Roboto. Text Effect Auto Chooses Auto, None, Shadow, Outline, or Outline + Shadow. Auto adds a shadow with a transparent background and none with an opaque box. Position Horizontal 50%, vertical 85% for newly created settings Click or drag the grid to move the subtitle stack. Both axes are limited to 2–98%.

Subtitle formats

These controls style text subtitles, including the primary and secondary text tracks. They do not restyle ASS/SSA, PGS, VobSub, DVB, or subtitles burned into the video.

See Enhanced features for subtitle previews and rendering limits.

Details

The vertical position locates the subtitle stack's lower edge. The position reset icon sets horizontal 50%, vertical 95%. Missing-value client fallbacks also use 95% vertically.

Roboto uses Roboto Mono. Colors, fonts, and sizes also apply to native browser cues, though their box styling differs.

When you open the panel, the format warning checks the primary subtitle track of the first controllable playing session. Reopen after changing tracks. No warning does not guarantee that the format is supported.

docs.title: Random Button Settings
docs.text:
The header's dice button helps you pick something to watch by opening a random item's details. It does not start playback automatically.

  1. Open Random Button Settings.
  2. Choose your per-user pool under Item Types and Random Source.
  3. Click the header dice button to pick an item.
Setting Default What it does Enable Random Button On Shows the header dice button. Unwatched Only Off Restricts candidates to unplayed movies/episodes or series with unwatched episodes. Movies On Includes movies. Shows On Includes series, and episodes within containers. At least one item type must remain selected. Use the playlist or collection I'm viewing Off Gives the current playlist/collection detail page priority over the pinned source. Everywhere else, pick from Whole library Pins an accessible playlist or collection for other pages. This choice has no admin counterpart. How it works

With current-container selection enabled, a readable playlist or collection on the current detail page takes priority. Otherwise, JE tries your pinned source.

If none is pinned, JE uses the whole library. A missing or invalid pinned source also uses the library, with a notice. If a resolved container's sample has no eligible items, JE goes directly to the whole library with a notice, bypassing the pinned source. Candidate-query errors show an error toast instead.

Container queries use direct children; whole-library queries are recursive. Each query samples at most 100 randomly ordered items. An empty filtered sample does not prove the entire source has no eligible items.

docs.title: UI Settings
docs.text:
Choose the extra information you see on item details and add removal buttons to home rows. These controls are per-user preferences.

Open UI Settings and turn on the options you want.

Setting Default What it does Show Watch Progress Off Adds watch progress to item details. Percentage / Time Watched / Time Remaining Percentage Chooses how Show Watch Progress shows progress. h:m / yd:h:m h:m Selects the time format for time-based progress displays. Show File Sizes Off Shows total file size on item details. Show Audio Languages On Shows available audio languages on item details. Add Remove from Continue Watching & Next Up Buttons Off Adds removal buttons to home rows and keeps your playback position.

Tag toggles, corners, category ordering, rating scopes, hover behavior, and the conditional native-client preference also live in UI Settings. See Tags & Badges for their complete settings reference.

How it works

The progress-display selector beneath Show Watch Progress has no separate label.

Row removal can work without the full Hidden Content feature when the administrator enables Enable "Remove from Continue Watching". The relevant Filter Continue Watching / Filter Next Up preferences and Enable Content Hiding must also remain on for server filtering.

To review or manually restore removed entries, the administrator must enable Enable Hidden Content. In its management page:

  • Use Add back to Continue Watching for a Continue Watching-only entry.
  • Use Unhide for Next Up or combined entries.

Resuming clears Continue Watching-only hides. Combined hides retain their Next Up scope. Next Up-only and global hides remain until removed manually. See Content management.

docs.title: Hidden Content
docs.text:
Choose where your saved hidden items disappear and where hide buttons appear. This personal section appears only when the administrator enables Hidden Content.

  1. Open Hidden Content and choose the filters and buttons you want.
  2. Click an item's open-eye Hide button to hide it.
  3. Use Manage Hidden Content to review or restore entries and see your hidden-item count.

All controls below are per-user preferences. The matching admin defaults are under Pages → Hidden Content.

Setting Default What it does Enable Content Hiding On Enables filtering for your account while the server feature is available. Show Hide Buttons On Shows hide controls. Turning it off leaves enabled filters working. Show Confirmation Dialog On Asks before hiding an item. Show on Seerr Items On Shows hide buttons on Seerr search/discovery cards. Show in Library Views Off Shows hide buttons on native library/home cards. Show on Detail Pages On Shows hide controls on supported item detail pages. Show on Cast/Actors Off Shows hide controls on cast/actor cards and supports hiding people. Filter Library On Filters native library browsing and supported related detail-page lists. Filter Discovery On Filters Seerr discovery. Filter Search Off Filters Jellyfin and Seerr search results. Filter Calendar On Filters the calendar. Filter Upcoming On Filters upcoming episodes. Filter Recommendations On Filters suggestions and similar/recommended rows. Filter Requests On Filters the Requests page. Filter Next Up On Filters the Next Up home row. Filter Continue Watching On Filters the Continue Watching home row. Hide Collections & Libraries Off Experimental: also allows hiding libraries, collections, and playlists.

Note

Global hides apply across the surfaces whose filters you enable. Search remains visible by default. Hiding changes browsing results; it does not revoke direct access or prevent playback. Experimental container hiding can disrupt browsing.

Details

Button locations and surface filters are under Hide Button Visibility. The experimental control is under Experimental. These preferences are stored in hidden-content.json. See Content management for scope choices and limits.

docs.title: Spoiler Guard
docs.text:
Choose which types of spoilers you want hidden. Your personal choices inherit the administrator's protection policy unless you opt out.

  1. Open Spoiler Guard when its server feature is enabled.
  2. Uncheck a category to opt out. Check it again to inherit the admin policy.
Setting Default What it does TV show descriptions Checked; inherit admin policy Hides protected show descriptions. Episode descriptions Checked; inherit admin policy Hides protected episode descriptions. Episode titles Checked; inherit admin policy Replaces protected episode titles. Chapter names Checked; inherit admin policy Hides protected chapter names. Cast list Checked; inherit admin policy Hides protected cast information. Ratings Checked; inherit admin policy Hides protected community/critic ratings. Air date Checked; inherit admin policy Hides protected air dates. Taglines Checked; inherit admin policy Hides protected taglines. Tags Checked; inherit admin policy Hides protected metadata tags. Reviews Checked; inherit admin policy Hides reviews in the protected web interface. Seek previews Checked; inherit admin policy Hides trickplay thumbnails while seeking through protected unwatched episodes and movies. Advanced per-category reveals Checked; inherit admin policy Uses the admin's enabled advanced reveals; unchecking restores stricter uniform protection. Don't ask me to confirm when turning Spoiler Guard off Off Skips the disable-confirmation dialog.

See Spoiler Guard settings for the admin controls and full protection rules.

Details

Category rows appear only when the administrator enables that category. Advanced per-category reveals appears only when advanced mode is enabled. These per-user preferences are stored in spoilerblur.json.

docs.title: Language Settings
docs.text:
Choose the language of JE's interface. This does not set your audio or subtitle language.

  1. Open Language Settings and choose Display Language.
  2. Wait about 1.5 seconds for the page to reload.
Setting Default What it does Display Language Auto Uses Jellyfin's resolved document language, or lets you choose a JE translation. New accounts start from the administrator's Default UI Language.

To clear this browser's JE translations, click Clear Translation Cache. The page reloads after about two seconds and keeps your feature preferences and language choice. See Other settings for server cache controls.

How it works

Changing Display Language saves the server preference and this browser's user-language key. An existing browser language key takes priority during translation loading. Changing the preference on another device does not automatically replace it. Choose the desired language in this browser if it continues to use an older choice.

Clear Translation Cache removes this browser's JE translation-cache entries. It differs from the server's Refresh Translation Cache scheduled task, which signals invalidation on clients' next load. Clearing does not guarantee a newer translation: bundled translations are tried first.

docs.title: About
docs.text:
Check About to see your installed plugin version. This section has no settings.

Choose Release Notes to fetch the latest GitHub release, or Contribute to open the project repository.

Details

Release Notes needs browser access to GitHub. The latest release may differ from your installed version.

docs.title: Feature Toggles
docs.text:
Use the admin configuration page to turn server features on and set starting preferences for users. You can search across tabs to find a control.

  1. Open Dashboard → Plugins → Jellyfin Enhanced.
  2. Select the appropriate tab, or use Search settings... to find controls across tabs. Clear the search to restore normal navigation.
  3. Change the controls and click Save Settings.
  4. Refresh affected web clients to load the new configuration.

Descriptions shows or hides explanations. Section jumps, previews, and navigation do not save edits; watch the unsaved indicator before leaving.

How it works

The tabs are Overview, Display, Playback, Pages, Seerr, *arr, Elsewhere & Reviews, Extras, Keyboard, Admin, and Docs. The configuration page uses #/configurationpage?name=Jellyfin%20Enhanced.

Some server effects happen immediately. Page integrations can have additional requirements, described below.

Overview contains Service Status, Optional Dependencies, Features, and Quick Actions. Status/feature cards take you to their configuration. Re-test all service connections runs service checks. Connection and URL-mapping tests are also available in their integration sections. Clear all client tag caches is a cache action, described in Tags & Badges.

What's new in v{version}: or What's new since you last checked: links to newly detected settings, with New in v{version} badges and release links. Dismiss acknowledges the shared server baseline; it does not enable features. Undismissed additions keep their first-detected version across releases.

A fresh installation establishes the current baseline. Existing plugin data can trigger the bundled 12.2.0.0 baseline when no acknowledgment exists. This is settings discovery rather than a complete release history.

docs.title: Server defaults and overwriting personal settings
docs.text:
Admin Display/Playback preferences generally supply starting values when a user settings file is missing. Existing personal values take precedence; ordinary Save Settings does not keep enforcing those defaults.

To replace existing preferences:

  1. Set and save the intended defaults.
  2. Choose Overview → Quick Actions → Overwrite everyone's personal settings.
  3. Confirm the action.

Warning

This action replaces personal customizations. Users must refresh and reapply choices they want to keep. It also resets personal-only values such as custom subtitle colors/position, the pinned random source, and last-opened section.

For the broader storage and backup reference, see Settings overview.

How it works

Server feature switches, such as Enable Hidden Content, control availability independently of a user's saved choice. Disabled child controls need their parent feature enabled.

After confirmation, the overwrite action saves the current form and synchronizes managed Custom Tabs entries. It replaces general settings for users with known JE data folders. It resets Hidden Content preferences while keeping hidden items. It also resets existing Spoiler Guard preferences to inherit the admin policy while keeping protected-title lists. Shortcut overrides in shortcuts.json remain.

In this version, the overwrite path resets watch-progress mode/time format to Percentage/h:m, even if the corresponding admin defaults differ.

docs.title: Display defaults
docs.text:
Choose the starting information new users see on item details. Users can override these admin preferences in UI Settings.

Open Display → UI Preferences and set the starting values:

Setting Default What it does Show watch progress Off Starts Show Watch Progress enabled for new users. Watch Progress Default Percentage Starts the personal display at Percentage, Time Watched, or Time Remaining. Watch Progress Time Format h:m Starts the personal time format at h:m or yd:h:m. Show file sizes Off Starts Show File Sizes enabled. Show available audio languages on item detail page On Starts Show Audio Languages enabled. Enable "Remove from Continue Watching" Off Starts Add Remove from Continue Watching & Next Up Buttons enabled.

Under Display → Icons & Theme, these are server settings with no personal-panel counterpart:

Setting Default What it does Use Icons in UI On Uses icons in JE's interface. Icon Style Emoji Chooses Emoji, Lucide Icons, or Material UI Icons.

Under Display → Default Language, choose the starting interface language:

Setting Default What it does Default UI Language System Default Supplies the initial personal Display Language. Users can choose their own language or Auto.

Display → Spoiler Guard is covered by Spoiler Guard settings. Display → Awards and MDBList Ratings are covered by Other settings.

docs.title: Playback defaults
docs.text:
Set starting playback preferences for your users, including tab switching, auto-skip, and subtitles. Users can override the personal preferences in Playback Settings, Auto-Skip Settings, and Subtitle Settings.

Open Playback → Playback & Tab Switch to set these starting preferences. The playback-start rating badge is a server setting with no personal toggle.

Setting Default What it does Auto-pause on tab switch On Starts personal Auto-pause enabled. Auto-resume on tab switch Off Starts personal Auto-resume enabled. Auto Picture-in-Picture on tab switch Off Starts personal Auto Picture-in-Picture enabled. Browser restrictions still apply. Long press/hold for 2x speed β Off Starts personal Long Press for 2x Speed (β) enabled. Supports mouse and touch. Enable Custom Pause Screen On Starts personal Custom Pause Screen enabled. Show Age Rating When Playback Starts Off Shows rating information when playback starts. No personal-panel toggle.

Player rating chips have a separate admin server control under Display → Media Tags:

Setting Default What it does Show Rating in Video Player On Adds community/critic rating chips beside the player's time information. Uses the server setting and has no personal-panel toggle.

Under Playback → Auto-Skip, choose starting preferences for Auto-Skip Settings:

Setting Default What it does Auto-skip Intro Off Starts Automatically Skip Intro enabled. Requires usable Intro segment data. Auto-skip Outro Off Starts Automatically Skip Outro enabled. Requires usable Outro segment data.

Under Playback → Subtitles, choose starting preferences for Subtitle Settings:

Setting Default What it does Disable Custom Subtitle Styles by default Off Starts Disable Custom Styles enabled. Users can override it. Default Subtitle Style Clean White Supplies the initial Style. Default Subtitle Size Normal Supplies the initial Size. Default Subtitle Font Default Supplies the initial Font. Default Subtitle Text Effect Auto Supplies the initial Text Effect.

See Subtitle Settings for choices and format limits.

Under Playback → Shortcuts Panel & Toast Timing, set these server timings. Use Preview autoclose and Preview toast to try them:

Setting Default What it does Shortcuts Panel Autoclose Delay (ms) 15000 Sets how long the Enhanced panel stays open with the pointer outside it. Toast Notification Duration (ms) 1500 Sets JE toast duration. Details

Show Age Rating When Playback Starts shows the official rating, up to three recognized advisory tags, and up to three genres for five seconds when playback starts. Episodes can fall back to series metadata.

There is no admin form input for the pause-screen delay. Its server configuration default is five seconds; users have Delay before showing (seconds):. Custom subtitle colors and position also have no admin form inputs.

docs.title: Random button defaults
docs.text:
Set the dice button's starting pool for new users. Users can override all five preferences in Random Button Settings.

Open Display → Random Button and choose the starting values:

Setting Default What it does Enable Random Button On Starts the header dice button enabled. Show unwatched only Off Starts Unwatched Only enabled. Include movies On Starts Movies selected. Include shows On Starts Shows selected. Scope to the current playlist or collection Off Starts Use the playlist or collection I'm viewing enabled.

Users choose their own pinned source; no admin control sets it. See Random Button Settings for source priority and sampling limits.

docs.title: Keyboard configuration
docs.text:
Set the server's keyboard bindings, which users inherit until they choose personal overrides. You can also disable ordinary JE shortcuts.

  1. Open Keyboard → Keyboard Config.
  2. Click a key and press a combination. Del disables the server binding; Backspace restores its stock key.
  3. Save your admin edits.
Setting Default What it does Disable Keyboard Shortcuts Off Disables ordinary JE shortcuts and hides the personal Shortcuts section. You can still open the panel with ?.

The editable action labels and stock keys match the Shortcuts table, except Jump to % of video, which is not in the admin recorder.

Details

Personal overrides remain in effect until users reset them in their own editor. Personal Backspace restores the saved administrator binding, which may differ from the stock key.

docs.title: Page entry points
docs.text: Enable the page under Pages, choose its placement, and click Save Settings. Bookmarks, Hidden Content, Activity, and Catch Up controls are listed below. Follow JE Pages & Tabs for native Home links, Plugin Pages registration, and automatic or manual Custom Tabs setup.

docs.title: Bookmarks
docs.text:
Bookmarks save positions within videos so you can return to them later. The bookmark library lets you manage those saved positions.

  1. Under Pages → Bookmarks, enable the server feature and choose an entry point.
  2. Create a bookmark in the player or with Bookmark Current Time.

These are admin server settings. There is no personal bookmark master toggle in the Enhanced panel.

Setting Default What it does Enable Bookmarks Feature On Enables bookmark tools and management. Add Bookmarks as a native Home tab Off Adds the built-in Bookmarks Home tab. Use Plugin Pages for Bookmarks Library Off Exposes the bookmark library through Plugin Pages. Use Custom Tabs for Bookmarks Off Enables the bookmark library's Custom Tabs embed. Add the Custom Tabs entry for me Off Creates the matching managed Custom Tabs entry on save.

Custom Tabs is optional. See Smart Bookmarks for editing, timeline markers, and management.

Details

Bookmark data is saved per account on the server in bookmark.json. The interface has no export/import operation.

docs.title: Hidden Content administration
docs.text:
Enable Hidden Content so users can manage their own hidden lists. When allowed, administrators can also inspect and edit other users' lists.

  1. Open Pages → Hidden Content.
  2. Enable the server feature and choose page access; expand Admin Controls to set administrator access to other users' hidden content.
  3. Under More Settings, set the starting personal preferences.

Admin server settings:

Setting Default What it does Enable Hidden Content Off Enables Hidden Content, its management page, and its personal panel section. Add Hidden Content as a native Home tab Off Adds the built-in Hidden Content Home tab. Use Plugin Pages for Hidden Content Off Exposes the page through Plugin Pages. Use Custom Tabs for Hidden Content Off Enables its Custom Tabs embed. Add the Custom Tabs entry for me Off Creates the matching managed Custom Tabs entry on save. Let admins view and manage other users' hidden content On Adds another-user selection to management. Viewing another account starts read-only; Edit enables changes on its behalf.
